b9209548c93a4823e42018cb6aef4ac3.overview: A well-to-do French family living in Calais deal with a series of setbacks and crises while paying little attention to the grim conditions in the refugee camps within a few miles of their home.
b9209548c93a4823e42018cb6aef4ac3.tagline: Don't believe the title of this Michael Haneke film.

b93b53e3f71e76700314c36cefff2044.overview: Bonded by their love of freediving, a record-setting champion and a heroic safety diver try to make history with a remarkable feat, ready to risk it all.
b93b53e3f71e76700314c36cefff2044.tagline: One dive. One breath. One chance.

b966edfe2b134301f1be2a9fbd32696f.overview: A depiction of the conflict between King Henry VIII of England and his Lord Chancellor, Sir Thomas More, who refuses to swear the Oath of Supremacy declaring Henry Supreme Head of the Church in England.

b9a5d4513126acf1d5b3fe5f9b568b4e.overview: Two young women and their friends spend spare time at an exclusive nightclub in 1980s New York.

b9ac434f0caf73565d53adf9b944ecca.overview: Fast-talking, quick-thinking Detroit street cop Axel Foley has bent more than a few rules and regs in his time, but when his best friend is murdered, he heads to sunny Beverly Hills to work the case like only he can.
b9ac434f0caf73565d53adf9b944ecca.tagline: He's been chased, thrown through a window and arrested. Eddie Murphy is a Detroit cop on vacation in Beverly Hills.

b9b40c8246b412c3b9f7e1e16a713017.overview: Sheila Rubin is a quietly tormented housewife in ’80s San Diego. Behind closed doors, she battles extreme personal demons and a vicious inner voice. But things change when she discovers aerobics, sparking a journey toward empowerment and success.

b9ed1557ef95fdbf7beacc80d4e41f7f.overview: American tourists David and Jack are savagely attacked by an unidentified animal while hiking on the Yorkshire Moors. After retiring to the home of a beautiful nurse to recuperate, David soon begins experiencing disturbing changes to his body and mind.

b9f55441138a0a81ecd5362aa50b9f2a.overview: John Anderton is a top 'Precrime' cop in the late-21st century, when technology can predict crimes before they're committed. But Anderton becomes the quarry when another investigator targets him for a murder charge.
